title: The prescribed pullback is its normalized coherent stage descent
statement: For a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω/Q_l and a scheme morphism g:X→Y with l invertible on both schemes, the normalized comparisons obtained by conjugating rationalPullbackScalarComparison by the recorded transition identifications form a coherent stage-system morphism. Its descended functor is exactly commonStageDerivedPullback, the uniquely specified quotient functor. No isomorphism, inverse family, shift, exactness or dimension hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Common-stage pullback paragraph; normalized comparison data and quotient representative uniqueness.

proof.text: Obtain the existing coherent pullback comparison data. Its component specification identifies its transition family with the rational scalar comparison conjugated by the recorded transition identifications; substitute that equality into its coherence law.

The stage-system morphism functor has the literal own-stage object formula and maps each quotient representative by conjugation with these comparisons. Rewrite the comparison components by the existing specification, then apply uniqueness of commonStageDerivedPullback.
